Name: List Regulatory Standards
Author: Admin
Description: List available regulatory standards in Microsoft Azure Security Center

Parameters.Description: Specify the ID of the subscription for which you want to query information. Note: if subscription ID is provided at the integration level and action level, priority will be given to action configuration.

Specify the comma-separated list of states. Example: Failed, Skipped. Only standards with the matching state will be returned. For example, if you specify “Failed”, action will only return failed standards. Possible values: Passed, Failed, Unsupported, Skipped
Specify how many standards to return.
